mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical norms reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market and robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals an impending monetary tightening cycle, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market and strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signal a restrictive monetary policy stance that dampens economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.
